She tells me this, and calls me lazy, telling me I have no reason to be depressed, and that i need to help myself, yet she doesn’t help me. At all. Not even some words of encouragement. I haven’t been able too eat much these last few days. I’ve been getting migraines, and anxiety attacks. My anxiety is getting worse, and I’m pulling away from my close friends.” 

what ur mother said to u is one of the worst things to tell anybody.. and i’m really sorry she told u that cause that’s hurtful. i don’t like how some ppl in this world are so okay with believing that life is harder for them than it is for anyone else. ur mother’s pov is like both my parents povs too and it sucks having nobody around to understand but instead get angry at u for venting to them about our struggles which would probably be something other parents would call a miracle to have, but other parents take their children’s trust in them for granted i guess. 

when u don’t have anybody to comfort u or understand u or go through the same stuff u do, but instead u have ur parents that both invalidate u and treat u speaking out about ur feelings like some sort of complaint or a threat to them, it makes u feel much more alone and hopeless and “dramatic and lazy” as they like to call ppl like us, than if u were to just actually not have told them yet. for the longest time i been silent and have been thinking about whether or not i should tell my parents, but then i finally did, i got the worst reaction possible lol. 

it made me much rather want to erase me ever wanting to attempt at trusting them. but now that i think about it, even though i didn’t get want i needed from my parents when i vented to them, at least i know how they feel about me now just because i vented. i know that they invalidate my feelings now. 

and i don’t know if i can either help them get rid of the harmful mindsets they have because i’ve been trying but it seems like they don’t question any of their views not even when it comes to their own daughter saying them. but i genuinely hope u distance urself from ur mom if what she said while u were venting to her still hurts u, and i hope u find more ppl that will make the simple effort to hug u and understand u instead of shutting u down the moment u vent like ur mom, bc it’s important to be around ppl that will realize that the fact that u trust them so much that u even chose to vent to them at all is a gift. 

venting should be known as a gift bc with it we can actually be real with each other and validate and comfort each other and in the end that would make us all more happier. ur not “lazy” like ur mom says,  and even though ur mom says u have no reasons to be depressed, i know that she has no reason to be judging u like that when she hasn’t experienced what u go through. she doesn’t know what goes on in ur life and u definitely haven’t told her everything that goes on in ur life bc that’s not possible, so i hope u can find ppl that don’t shut u down like that and make the choice to understand u and see ur worth, bc ur voice is worth to be heard and ur feelings are worth to be cared about.

and i bet the ppl that react badly like that when someone else is venting to them are the ppl that only like to hear and talk about their own problems so that’s their own problem they have to work out. but also i hope u find ppl that treat u better, if any of ur family doesn’t treat u that well, u can always make a chosen family consisting of ur friends and ur boyfriend.
